Does Brad Pitt die in Snatch?

He plays Mickey O'Neil.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows the answer, the scene, and a clip if we have one.

No. Fakes taking a dive, wins the fight, and his camp settles up with Brick Top.

Bare-knuckle champion Mickey is ordered by gangster Brick Top to throw a fight; when Mickey refuses, Brick Top has his mother burned alive in her caravan. Mickey pretends to comply, then knocks his opponent out in the fourth round while his people ambush and kill Brick Top and his men outside. The travellers vanish before dawn.

Mickey's mum dies; Mickey doesn't.
